characters.name: Shiva

visual_details.accessories: Serpents around neck, crescent moon in hair, Ganga flowing from hair, damaru (drum)
visual_details.notable_features: Third eye blazing on forehead, glowing skin, cosmic aura

characters.overall_description: Wild creatures witnessing the divine presence of Shiva from a distance.

characters.name: Serpents
characters.overall_description: Serpents loosely coiled around Shiva’s neck, calm and symbolic.
